summary: Iran launched two ballistic missiles toward the UAE, with one landing in Emirati territorial waters, prompting the UAE to halt all trade and financial transactions with Iran. Israel conducted airstrikes in Gaza targeting Hamas and Islamic Jihad commanders, including a company commander involved in the October 7 attacks. Israel also struck a Syrian airbase near Aleppo to prevent Turkish military deployment.
key_points: Iran fired two ballistic missiles at the UAE, one falling outside territorial waters and the second within them, placing Emirati forces on full alert. (Source: @New_security8200/203360)
The UAE suspended all activities, barter trade, and financial transactions with Iran indefinitely due to regional escalation following the missile launches. (Source: @N12chat/222522)
Israel struck a meeting of Hamas Nukhba commanders in Gaza, killing a company commander, three platoon commanders, and other militants planning attacks against IDF forces. (Source: @amitsegal/64018)

Israeli forces eliminated Islamic Jihad supply company commander Tarek Anwar Hamis Ra'i in Khan Younis, who had infiltrated Kibbutz Be'eri and abducted an Israeli civilian on October 7. (Source: @inon_yttach/9868)

Israel conducted eight airstrikes on Syria's Abu al-Duhur military airport in Idlib province, damaging the runway and abandoned hangars, to prevent Turkish troop deployment. (Source: @New_security8200/203353)

Prime Minister Netanyahu's office confirmed the Syrian strikes, stating Syria breached security understandings by allowing Turkish forces at an airbase near Aleppo despite repeated Israeli warnings. (Source: @manniefabian/58992)

President Trump declared no negotiations with Iran are occurring or planned, asserting the naval blockade remains, the Strait of Hormuz is open, and all naval mines have been cleared. (Source: @kianmeli1/90917)

sections.executive_summary: Iran launched two ballistic missiles toward the UAE, with one landing in Emirati territorial waters, prompting the UAE to halt all trade and financial transactions with Iran. Israel conducted airstrikes in Gaza targeting Hamas and Islamic Jihad commanders, including a company commander involved in the October 7 attacks. Israel also struck a Syrian airbase near Aleppo to prevent Turkish military deployment.

points: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei questioned the United States' ability to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, challenging U.S. maritime claims in the strategic waterway. (Source: @presstv/203299)

President Trump stated no negotiations with Iran are underway or planned, the naval blockade remains in full force, the Strait of Hormuz is open and operational, and all naval mines have been collected or detonated. (Source: @kianmeli1/90917)

Iran's foreign ministry rejected accusations that it launched missiles toward the UAE, denying responsibility for the two ballistic missiles reported by Emirati defense authorities. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88122)
Iranians continued street demonstrations for the 171st consecutive night in support of the country since the start of the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, according to state media. (Source: @presstv/203290)

France expelled two Iranian diplomats in retaliation for the alleged assault on two French diplomats in Iran on July 19, with the French foreign minister citing Iran's repression of protests and support for artists and researchers. (Source: @VahidOnline/77944)

Qatar's foreign ministry spokesperson labeled Iran's request for an International Red Cross committee on Iranian pilots a 'media stunt' and said Iran has not responded to Doha's invitation to send a delegation to discuss the matter. (Source: @VahidOnline/77935)

The U.S. Justice Department charged 17 Iranians with conducting a massive cyber theft campaign on behalf of the IRGC and the Mabna Institute, targeting hundreds of universities and companies to steal research and intellectual property. (Source: @shin_persian/9020)

The IDF struck a meeting of Hamas Nukhba commanders in the Shati area of northern Gaza, killing a company commander, three platoon commanders, and additional militants who were planning terror attacks against Israeli forces operating in the strip. (Source: @amitsegal/64018)

Israeli forces eliminated Islamic Jihad supply company commander Tarek Anwar Hamis Ra'i in Khan Younis two days ago; he had infiltrated Kibbutz Be'eri and abducted an Israeli civilian during the October 7 massacre. (Source: @inon_yttach/9868)

Israel conducted eight airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur military airport in Syria's Idlib province, hitting the runway and abandoned aircraft hangars, with no reported casualties but property damage confirmed. (Source: @New_security8200/203353)

Prime Minister Netanyahu's office confirmed the Syrian strikes, stating Syria violated security understandings by permitting Turkish troops to deploy at an airbase near Aleppo despite repeated Israeli warnings, and Israel will not tolerate such threats. (Source: @manniefabian/58992)

The IDF renewed its operational shooting instructor course for special units with updated curriculum including improved weaponry, anti-drone training, and expanded battalions, incorporating lessons from the ongoing campaign. (Source: @idf_telegram/24923)

Israeli Attorney General stated 80% of ultra-Orthodox men still evade conscription, urging expanded economic enforcement against each individual and renewed police and IDF arrests of deserters. (Source: @amitsegal/64014)

Israeli police thwarted a car bomb attack planned by a Bedouin resident of the Negev town of Shaqib al-Salam targeting the Forum nightclub in Be'er Sheva, seizing multiple firearms including a MAG, Kalashnikov, Negev rifle, M16, magazines, and ammunition. (Source: @almogboker78/17989)

IDF airstrikes in the Shati area of northern Gaza targeted Hamas commanders planning attacks against Israeli forces, with steps taken to minimize civilian harm according to the military spokesperson. (Source: @amitsegal/64012)

Islamic Jihad supply company commander Tarek Anwar Hamis Ra'i was killed in Khan Younis; he had participated in the October 7 infiltration of Kibbutz Be'eri and abduction of an Israeli civilian. (Source: @inon_yttach/9868)

An Israeli couple with a one-year-old toddler entered Jericho in Area A for shopping and were rescued by Judea and Samaria District police after being detained, highlighting the danger of Israeli civilians entering Palestinian-controlled areas. (Source: @pkpoi/143647)

Hamas Nukhba commanders were struck while meeting in a cafe in Gaza, including a company commander, three platoon commanders, and other militants advancing terror plans against IDF troops. (Source: @almogboker78/17996)

The IDF announced the recovery of findings related to Sgt. First Class Yehuda Katz, missing since the 1982 Battle of Sultan Yacoub in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley, where 21 Israeli servicemen were killed and over 30 injured during a skirmish with the Syrian army. (Source: @New_security8200/203352)

The battle of Sultan Yacoub occurred 44 years ago during the First Lebanon War; Katz went missing along with two other soldiers, whose remains were later recovered — Zachary Baumel in 2019 with Russian assistance, and Zvi Feldman's remain unrecovered. (Source: @manniefabian/58985)

Unknown explosions were reported in the Syrian city of Tartus, though a local source later stated the sounds were from fireworks only and no security incident occurred. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88131, @rasedal3ado138e/385553)

Israel struck the Abu al-Duhur military airport in Idlib province with eight airstrikes, damaging the runway and abandoned hangars, to prevent Turkish forces from deploying at the base near Aleppo. (Source: @New_security8200/203353)

Netanyahu's office said Syria ignored repeated Israeli warnings that Turkish troop deployment at a Syrian airbase near Aleppo would threaten Israel's security, leading to the strikes to restore the status quo. (Source: @manniefabian/58992)

The UAE defense ministry reported two ballistic missiles launched from Iran, with the first falling outside UAE territorial waters and the second landing within them; Emirati forces are at full readiness to confront any threat. (Source: @New_security8200/203360)
The UAE halted all activities, barter trade, and financial transactions with Iran until further notice due to regional escalation following the missile launches. (Source: @N12chat/222522)
UAE air defense systems were activated at 1502Z (18:32 Tehran time) amid the missile threat, according to social media reports citing the UAE defense ministry. (Source: @shin_persian/9012)

Qatar's foreign ministry spokesperson said Iran has not responded to Doha's invitation to send a delegation to discuss the Iranian pilots' case, calling Tehran's request for an International Red Cross committee a 'media stunt.' (Source: @VahidOnline/77935)

President Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz open and operational, all naval mines cleared, and the naval blockade on Iran continuing at full strength, with no negotiations planned. (Source: @kianmeli1/90917)

sections.threat_assessment: The Iranian missile launches toward the UAE represent a significant escalation in direct state-on-state aggression, testing Emirati and U.S. deterrence posture in the Gulf. Israel's simultaneous strikes in Gaza and Syria indicate a multi-front operational tempo aimed at degrading Hamas and Islamic Jihad command structures while preempting Turkish military entrenchment near Aleppo. The UAE's immediate economic decoupling from Iran signals a hardening of Gulf Arab positions, potentially isolating Tehran further. Trump's public dismissal of negotiations and assertion of cleared mines in the Strait of Hormuz suggests a U.S. strategy of maximum pressure without diplomatic off-ramps, increasing the risk of miscalculation in the maritime domain.
sections.regional_response: The UAE has moved to full military readiness and severed economic ties with Iran, aligning with a broader Gulf trend of confronting Iranian missile threats. Qatar maintains a diplomatic channel but publicly rebukes Iran's procedural tactics regarding the pilots' case. France has retaliated diplomatically by expelling Iranian envoys, Europeanizing the conflict's diplomatic dimension. Turkey's planned deployment in Syria has drawn a direct Israeli military response, complicating Ankara's regional ambitions. The Palestinian arena sees continued Israeli targeting of mid-level commanders, aiming to disrupt operational planning without large-scale ground maneuvers.
sections.intelligence_notes: The recovery of artifacts linked to Yehuda Katz after 44 years demonstrates Israel's persistent intelligence and forensic capabilities regarding missing personnel, potentially leveraging Russian or Syrian cooperation. The thwarted car bombing in Be'er Sheva reveals ongoing threats from radicalized Bedouin elements inside Israel, with significant weapon caches indicating possible external support. The cyber indictments of 17 Iranians highlight the continuing IRGC-linked intellectual property theft campaign, which remains a strategic priority for Western law enforcement. The conflicting reports on Tartus explosions underscore the fog of war in Syria, where attribution remains difficult amid multiple actors.
